t: Calculate Delayed Arrival Time — Modular Clock Arithmetic
o: New arrival time is (arrivalTime + delayedTime) mod 24, since the clock wraps at 24. Example 1: (15+5) mod 24 = 20. Example 2: (13+11) mod 24 = 0. O(1).

a.i: Add and reduce modulo 24; JavaScript's % already returns nonnegative results for positive operands here.
a.t: O(1) — one addition and one modulo

w: Nothing to trip on; both operands are positive so no negative-modulo concerns. Follow-up: minutes granularity ((h*60+m + delay) % 1440).
